messages:
nia-cs: Quick heads-up 1 Aurora Dataworks renewal hits next Tue. They want to shorten to a 6-month term and be billed monthly. Asking for an 8% discount and 2 enablement credits. Procurement needs our EU vendor code + exact VAT on invoice. DocuSign is blocked by their IT policy for third-party e-sign. Need alignment on pricing math, VAT handling, and a signature fallback. cc @oliver-fin @emma-legal @lee-enable

rachel-se: Thanks Nia. Whats the current onboarding status? Any blockers that make us want a different cadence?

nia-cs: Onboarding ~85%: SSO mapping complete, ingest tests scheduled but pending sample data from customer. They want enablement before cutover, which is why credits are in play.

oliver-fin: Ballpark pricing: baseline $140/seat/month. Confirm seat count?

nia-cs: Theyre starting with 25 seats.

oliver-fin: Ok math: 25 * $140 = $3,500/month. For 6 months pre-discount = $21,000. 8% discount => $19,320 total. If they insist monthly billing, that's $3,500 - 8% = $3,220/month. Need to confirm preferred payment method (wire vs card) and PO timing.

emma-legal: We can accommodate a 6-month term. I'll draft an addendum to reflect monthly billing and pro-rata/cancellation rules. For VAT: invoice must list the EU billing entity and VAT ID; otherwise we invoice from our US entity and VAT is customer's responsibility. Regarding e-sign: if DocuSign is blocked, we accept secure upload of signed PDF or wet-sign. I'll add a clause: "Alternate: secure portal upload with attestations when e-sign not permitted."

lee-enable: I can run 2 enablement sessions in the week after sign (technical + admin). Will need access to their SSO metadata and the sample ingest files.

esign-bot: DocuSign: Envelope 0xD4f created by nia-cs  Status: failed (policy block by cobalt-it).

nia-cs: They pushed back on DocuSign; I uploaded secure link for signed docs: https://files.redwood.com/upload/aurora-2026-xyz. Procurement replied they'll wet-sign and wire payment.

oliver-fin: If they wire and provide PO with billing entity + VAT, finance is OK. Quick alternative to discount: offer 5% + 1 enablement credit (saves $$ vs 8%); but if they insist on 8% and we get PO/wire before EOD Tue we can approve. Decision needed: discount vs credits trade.

emma-legal: Legal is neutral on discount structure. Approve 8% if finance signs off and we get PO with entity/VAT and signatory authority. I'll fast-track the addendum once finance confirms.

nia-cs: Customer replied: prefer straight 8% discount and monthly invoices. They will send PO from their EU entity with VAT.

oliver-fin: OK from finance as long as PO includes billing entity + VAT and payment terms Net30 on monthly invoices. Send PO and wire instructions to billing@redwood.com. I'll note the revenue as monthly-recurring.

rachel-se: I'll hold the rollout until enablement completes and ingest test passes. @lee-enable please confirm availability when PO is in.

lee-enable: Will block time week of 2026-04-13 pending signed PO.

emma-legal: Action: I'll post the 6-month addendum in the contract thread by EOD today and include the secure-upload signature clause.

nia-cs: Plan recap: 1) Customer to send PO with EU billing entity + VAT and wet-signed PDF (secure upload ok) by Tue EOD; 2) Finance will confirm monthly wire/card handling and finalize invoice format; 3) Legal to publish 6-month addendum today; 4) Enablement scheduled week after sign; 5) Rachel to hold rollout until ingest tests pass. I'll update the renewal risk tracker when PO received.

oliver-fin: Sounds good. Please ping me the PO when uploaded.

nia-cs: Will do  closing here once PO & signed docs are uploaded. Thanks team.
